content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- ') and 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- " and trailing " RELEASED_AT TODO"
        rest = line[2:].replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '')
        # Split on " BY " to get title and artists
        if ' BY ' in rest:
            title_part, artists_part = rest.split(' BY ', 1)
            title = title_part.strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
            songs_todo.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
        else:
            print(f"Could not parse line: {line}")
print(f"Found {len(songs_todo)} songs with TODO")
for s in songs_todo:
    print(s)
